naslov: Miami visits Los Angeles following Doncic's 45-point game
tekst:
Miami Heat (2-4, 11th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Los Angeles Lakers (5-2, fourth in the Western Conference)
              Los Angeles; Monday, 10 p.m. EST
              LINE: Lakers -2.5; over/under is 238.5
              BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles plays the Miami Heat after Luka Doncic scored 45 points in the Los Angeles Lakers' 131-125 victory over the Toronto Raptors.
